placements.why: The content is a test specification that reproduces a production failure pattern and constrains correct behavior — this is proof-grain organizational content, and nothing in the existing (empty) strata or graph covers it.
placements.title: From production defect to demanded correctness
placements.frame: What evidence does a test provide about the failure it reproduces and the behavior it requires?

placements.title: Reproduction as specification of the defect and the demand
placements.frame: How does a test case encode both the production failure it reproduces and the behavioral constraint it must satisfy?
placements.why: src-1 names the concrete failure pattern the test mirrors (a ## heading with no id field from prod), while src-2 states the non-negotiable behavioral constraint the system must meet when facing that pattern (must not crash, must produce a valid slug). Together they form a thematic subject — test-as-reproduction-of-failure — that future envelopes will keep feeding. The conviction gradient (flat claim then settled decision) is the natural shape of a test specification, and the position pass already grouped these two as ReproAndConstraint.
consulted: position pass — ReproAndConstraint groups src-1 and src-2
